id: 29_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the wire feeding nozzle
title: 激光焊接机更换送丝导嘴
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/29_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the wire feeding nozzle.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/29_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the wire feeding nozzle/src.py

points.K1: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个小小的铜色导嘴，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a tiny knurled brass wire feeding nozzle and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲送丝导嘴怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换送丝导嘴

shots.scene: 送丝机、送丝管、焊枪连成一线的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire feeder, a long wire feeding tube and a handheld welding gun joined in a line. No people.
shots.narration: 导嘴装在送丝管的末端。

shots.scene: 阿杰换上了一卷粗焊丝
shots.prompt_en: The young male student mounts a thicker wire spool in the wire feeder.
shots.narration: 阿杰把焊丝换成了1.2毫米的。

shots.scene: 焊丝卡在送丝管末端的小导嘴前
shots.prompt_en: The wire jams at the small brass nozzle at the end of the feeding tube. No people.
shots.narration: 可送丝时，焊丝卡在导嘴前。

shots.scene: 小研拿起送丝管末端看了看，摇摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the nozzle end of the feeding tube, looks at it and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研一看：导嘴还是细丝用的。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们来看导嘴怎么换。

shots.section_title: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴
shots.scene: 送丝管两端：一端普通，一端带卡扣和铜导嘴
shots.prompt_en: A wire feeding tube laid out on the bench: one plain end, and one end with a clamp and a brass nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝管有一头带卡扣，
overlay: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴

shots.section_title: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴
shots.scene: 卡扣端特写，铜导嘴被圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the clamp end of the tube with the brass nozzle marked by a green circle. No people.
shots.narration: 这一头装着送丝导嘴。

shots.section_title: 送丝管卡扣端装可换导嘴
shots.scene: 铜导嘴特写，旁边一个旋转箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the brass nozzle with a circular arrow showing it can be unscrewed. No people.
shots.narration: 导嘴可以拧下来更换。

shots.scene: 两个铜导嘴并排，一个孔小一个孔大
shots.prompt_en: Two brass nozzles side by side, one with a small hole and one with a larger hole, each with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 导嘴有两种规格。

shots.scene: 小孔导嘴放大，刻印处空白
shots.prompt_en: A magnified view of the small-hole nozzle with a blank engraved band. No people.

shots.scene: 大孔导嘴放大，刻印处空白
shots.prompt_en: A magnified view of the large-hole nozzle with a blank engraved band. No people.

shots.scene: 小孔导嘴用线连着两卷细焊丝
shots.prompt_en: Lines link the small-hole nozzle to two thin wire spools. No people.

shots.scene: 大孔导嘴用线连着两卷粗焊丝
shots.prompt_en: Lines link the large-hole nozzle to two thick wire spools. No people.

shots.scene: 老李看焊丝盘上的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the blank label on the wire spool.
shots.narration: 先看清焊丝的直径，

shots.scene: 老李在送丝机旁手持送丝管末端，拧下旧导嘴
shots.prompt_en: Standing beside the wire feeder, the facility engineer holds the end of the feeding tube and unscrews the old nozzle.
shots.narration: 拧下送丝管末端的旧导嘴，

shots.scene: 老李拧上另一种规格的导嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws the nozzle of the other size onto the tube end.
shots.narration: 换上和焊丝对应的导嘴。

shots.scene: 一张两行的对照表，左边导嘴图标，右边焊丝图标
shots.prompt_en: A two-row matching chart: nozzle icons on the left, wire spool icons on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 丝径和导嘴，照对照表来配。

shots.scene: 焊丝从新导嘴伸出，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The wire comes out of the new nozzle, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 导嘴和焊丝对上了。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现送丝管和两个导嘴图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with icons behind: a feeding tube with a clamp end and two nozzles.
shots.narration: 送丝管卡扣端，装着可换的导嘴。

shots.scene: 两个导嘴各连两卷焊丝
shots.prompt_en: Two nozzles, each linked by lines to two wire spools. No people.
shots.narration: 两种规格，各配两种丝径。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 按焊丝直径，换对应的导嘴。

shots.scene: 阿杰的焊丝顺利送出，他竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The wire now feeds smoothly through the new nozzle and the young male student gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰换对导嘴，送丝顺畅了。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研和阿杰挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 导嘴换好了，下次见！
